<documents>
<document id="cushion-basic">
CushionˆonˆBasicˆCushionˆisn'tˆavailableˆonˆtheˆBasicˆplan.ˆOnˆBasic,ˆaˆdebitˆcardˆpurchaseˆlargerˆthanˆyourˆbalanceˆisˆdeclined,ˆwithˆnoˆfee.ˆ##ˆWhyˆCushionˆisˆpartˆofˆtheˆpaidˆplans.ˆIt'sˆhowˆweˆgiveˆmembersˆaˆlittleˆroomˆwithoutˆchargingˆoverdraftˆfees.ˆ##ˆGettingˆCushionˆMoveˆtoˆPlusˆforˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$50.00,ˆorˆtoˆPremiumˆforˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$200.ˆYou'llˆalsoˆneedˆatˆleastˆ$500ˆinˆdirectˆdepositsˆinˆtheˆlastˆ30ˆdays.ˆ##ˆOverdraftˆfeesˆBasicˆhasˆnoˆoverdraftˆfeesˆ($0.00).ˆTransactionsˆthatˆwouldˆoverdrawˆyourˆaccountˆareˆdeclinedˆinstead.ˆ##ˆCanˆaˆBasicˆbalanceˆgoˆnegative?ˆOccasionally,ˆforˆexampleˆifˆaˆmerchantˆpostsˆmoreˆthanˆitˆauthorizedˆorˆaˆdisputeˆcreditˆisˆtakenˆback.ˆAddˆmoneyˆtoˆbringˆitˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆAnyˆdepositˆrepaysˆaˆnegativeˆbalanceˆautomatically.ˆThere'sˆnoˆfeeˆforˆaˆdeclinedˆtransaction.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="cushion-how-it-works">
HowˆCushionˆworksˆCushionˆisˆfee-freeˆoverdraftˆcoverageˆforˆdebitˆcardˆpurchases,ˆavailableˆonˆPlusˆandˆPremium.ˆ##ˆHowˆmuchˆitˆcoversˆ-ˆPlus:ˆupˆtoˆ$50.00ˆ-ˆPremium:ˆupˆtoˆ$200ˆ-ˆBasic:ˆnotˆavailableˆ##ˆWhoˆcanˆuseˆitˆYouˆneedˆatˆleastˆ$500ˆinˆdirectˆdepositsˆinˆtheˆlastˆ30ˆdays.ˆTurnˆitˆonˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆCushion.ˆ##ˆWhatˆitˆcoversˆDebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆonly,ˆincludingˆmobileˆwalletˆpayments.ˆItˆneverˆcoversˆATMˆwithdrawals,ˆtransfers,ˆBrookPay,ˆwiresˆorˆplanˆfees.ˆ##ˆWhatˆitˆcostsˆNothing.ˆCushionˆhasˆnoˆfeesˆ($0.00)ˆandˆnoˆinterest.ˆ##ˆPayingˆitˆbackˆYourˆnextˆdepositˆrepaysˆitˆautomatically.ˆIfˆyourˆbalanceˆstaysˆnegativeˆforˆ30ˆdays,ˆCushionˆisˆsuspended.ˆSeeˆ"RepayingˆCushion".ˆ##ˆTurningˆitˆoffˆYouˆcanˆswitchˆCushionˆoffˆatˆanyˆtimeˆinˆtheˆsameˆplace.ˆPurchasesˆlargerˆthanˆyourˆbalanceˆareˆthenˆdeclined,ˆwithˆnoˆfee.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="direct-deposit-setup">
SettingˆupˆdirectˆdepositˆDirectˆdepositˆsendsˆyourˆpaycheck,ˆorˆbenefits,ˆstraightˆintoˆyourˆTallowbrookˆaccount.ˆ##ˆSetˆitˆupˆ-ˆ**Automatic:**ˆtapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆDirectˆdeposit,ˆthenˆSetˆupˆautomatically.ˆFindˆyourˆemployerˆorˆpayrollˆproviderˆandˆsignˆin.ˆTheˆswitchˆhappensˆinˆtheˆpayrollˆsystem.ˆ-ˆ**Manual:**ˆdownloadˆaˆpre-filledˆdirectˆdepositˆformˆfromˆtheˆsameˆscreen,ˆorˆcopyˆyourˆroutingˆandˆaccountˆnumber,ˆandˆgiveˆitˆtoˆyourˆemployer.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆEmployersˆusuallyˆneedˆoneˆorˆtwoˆpayˆcyclesˆtoˆmakeˆtheˆswitch.ˆYourˆfirstˆpaycheckˆmayˆstillˆgoˆtoˆyourˆoldˆaccount.ˆ##ˆWhyˆitˆhelpsˆ-ˆYouˆmayˆgetˆpaidˆupˆtoˆ2ˆdaysˆearly.ˆ-ˆPlusˆandˆPremiumˆmembersˆneedˆatˆleastˆ$500ˆinˆdirectˆdepositsˆinˆtheˆlastˆ30ˆdaysˆtoˆuseˆCushion.ˆ##ˆSplittingˆaˆpaycheckˆYourˆemployerˆmayˆletˆyouˆsplitˆyourˆpayˆbetweenˆaccounts.ˆYouˆcanˆalsoˆsetˆupˆanˆautomaticˆtransferˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆtoˆaˆSavingsˆPocketˆonˆpayday.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
